claim: An Instagram reel posted by Ian Byington (Instagram URL https://www.instagram.com/reel/DUMnu1rjVUq/) opens with an image of a horned Baal/Moloch deity and asserts a series of specific claims about what the released Epstein documents contain. Tested against this site's local mirror of the DOJ Epstein-files release (4,333 documents, indexed at /efta/), the reel's central claims fail verification: (1) Whole-word "Baal" returns five hits — all of which are optical-character-recognition artifacts from low-quality Deutsche Bank statement scans (the OCR engine read "Total NSF return item" and "Legal name, first" as "Baal"). No human-authored reference to Baal, Moloch, or child-sacrifice deity-worship appears in the corpus. (2) The reel claims "Israel is mentioned twice as much as Donald Trump in the new documents." In the corpus, word-boundary case-insensitive counts give Trump 1,187 mentions across 376 documents versus Israel + Israeli 412 mentions across ~120 documents — Trump is mentioned roughly 2.9× MORE often than Israel, the opposite of the reel's claim. (3) The reel attributes a "Jews create vast fortunes by manipulating markets… let the goyim deal in the real world" quote to a conversation between Jeffrey Epstein and Roger Schank, characterized as a "Jewish American academic and hedge fund worker." Schank is a real Epstein correspondent in the corpus, but he was an artificial-intelligence and education researcher (founder of Engines for Education), not a hedge-fund worker; and the actual Schank ↔ Epstein emails in the corpus (HOUSE_OVERSIGHT_030483, _030484, _029901, EFTA01788342) are about Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation education-grant policy and teacher pay, not the quoted content. (4) The reel's Rothschild–Ukraine "overthrow" conversation and $25-million-for-algorithms payment do not appear in the corpus: zero documents contain both "Rothschild" and any "Ukrain*" form. (5) Searches for "Larry Fink," "Joshua Fink," "Joshua Finkelstein," "100% Jewish," "Hire Jews," "genetically Jewish," and "child sacrifice" return zero matches. The corpus's only "Svetlana" hit is a Commerzbank account holder named in a Deutsche Bank wire-transfer schedule, unrelated to the BlackRock-son narrative the reel asserts. (6) The corpus's single "Jewish supremacy" hit (EFTA01652796) is a 2025 forwarded external email circulating a Medium opinion piece by Rima Najjar — not a finding in Epstein's own files.

notes: This record exists to publish a viral-claim-vs-record verification — the editorial premise of 2pizzaclub.com. The reel's specific named individuals who DO appear in the corpus appear in DIFFERENT contexts than the reel claims: Schank correspondence is about education, Svetlana is a banking account holder, Maria Farmer is named in a third-party tip-style document (EFTA01652971) rather than testimony. The reel's central deity-worship/child-sacrifice framing and its quantitative Israel-vs-Trump claim both fail against the actual documents. The corpus is the published DOJ release; the reel's claims are not. Local search methodology: case-insensitive word-boundary regex against the `text` field of each document JSON under efta/docs/. Counts on 2026-05-22.
